# has data subject

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasDataSubject`](gmeow-hasDataSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDataSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The data subject whose personal data is governed by a rights statement — the individual about whom personal data is processed. Not a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md) because a rights statement (an ODRL policy) is not an agreement; the party model is reused at the licence level.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the data subject a consent or processing rights statement is about — the person whose personal data is processed under rules over [`gmeow:actionProcessPersonalData`](../individuals/gmeow-actionProcessPersonalData.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating it as a party-to-agreement subproperty (a [`RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) is an ODRL policy, not an agreement — the party model is reused at the licence level) and avoid using it for the processing agent, which is [`gmeow:hasDataController`](gmeow-hasDataController.md).

### How to use

- Add [`gmeow:hasDataSubject`](gmeow-hasDataSubject.md) to a [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) whose rules regulate [`gmeow:actionProcessPersonalData`](../individuals/gmeow-actionProcessPersonalData.md); pair with [`gmeow:hasDataController`](gmeow-hasDataController.md) and purpose/recipient constraints to model the consent posture.

### Examples

- ex:consentPolicy [`gmeow:hasDataSubject`](gmeow-hasDataSubject.md) ex:janeDoe.
